captions.detailed: A counterbalance drafting floor lamp featuring a circular base, a tall vertical post, and a horizontal boom arm. The boom arm is balanced on a pivot joint at the top of the post, with a cylindrical counterweight on one end and a conical lamp shade on the other. The boom pivots about a horizontal axis via a revolute joint, while the shade assembly rotates at the terminal end of the arm.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a counterbalance drafting floor lamp with a round base, a tall vertical post, and a horizontal boom arm. The boom arm should pivot on a horizontal revolute joint at the top of the post, balancing a cylindrical counterweight on one side and a conical lamp shade on the other, with the shade itself rotating on a terminal revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct a base using a thin cylinder, topped with a smaller vertical post cylinder. Model the pivot bracket at the top of the post using a combination of boxes and cylinders. Define a boom arm using a long horizontal cylinder, appending a cylindrical counterweight to the short end. Model the lamp shade using a hollowed conical frustum (or a lofted shell) and attach it to the long end of the boom arm. Create two revolute joints: one for the horizontal pivot of the boom arm relative to the post, and one for the rotation of the lamp shade at the end of the arm.
